profile.headline: Creative System & Firmware engineer
profile.summary:
Firmware engineer over 15 years in Mobile Device Development. Coding experience at user, kernel and low levels. Reputation for efficiency, continuous process input, and excellent communications. Skills include the following:

●	Languages		 	       C / Assembly / C++/ Viaual C++ / Perl / Python
●	Debugging Tools 		       Source Insight / Trace32 / ADB
				                       Qualcomm Tools ( QXDM /QPST / QCAT )
●	Version Controls 		       Git / Rational Clearcase / Perforce 
●	Platforms 			       Linux, ThreadX, Android, REX, BREW
●	Development Equipment       JTAG / ETM / HAPS / CHIPIT / Palladium / Callbox


HIGHLIGHTS
●	Over 15 years in embedded SW development experience.
●	Experience in multi-platforms from low level to high level
●	Experience in porting software components(FOTA/IOTA/BREW)
●	Experience in developing Bootrom and Bootloaders(BIOS/Coreboot/Uboot/Proprietary)
●	Experience in pre-silicon development environments(HAPS/CHIPIT/Palladium)
●	Experience in board bring up
●	Experience in debugging with JTAG/ETM
●	Experience in ARM architectures and Trustzone
●	Experience in leading team
●	Solid in software development process
●	Solid in tools & development environments
●	Strong skills in communication, relationship building, analytical and problem solving.
●	Great team player, hard-working, has a passion to learn and work.


WORK PROFILE
●	Sr Software engineer, Intel San Diego (2015 ~ Present)
●	Principle Engineer, Verifone San Diego (2014 ~ 2015)
●	Sr. Staff ~ Sr. Principle Engineer, Broadcom, San Diego(2007 to 2014)
●	Staff Engineer, Motorola, San Diego(2003 to 2007)
●	Sr. Engineer, Motorola, Korea (2000 to 2003)
●	Software Engineer, ACE Technology, Korea (1999 to 2000)
●	Software Engineer, K2R, Korea(1998 to 1999)

positions.title: Senior software Engineer
positions.description:
As development engineer in platform team, developing Intel Bootloaders, bringing up customized boards and leading/working on platform stability issue in Intel platforms

Key accomplishments include:
●	Developing Bootloaders and bring up customized boards
-	BIOS for Cherrytrail and Apollolake
-	FSP and Coreboot for Cherrytrail
-	Bring up customized boards

●	Platform stability
-	Setting and designing goal and reviewing test items and scripts
-	Triaging and debugging general crashes and stress test failures.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
As development engineer, designed and developed DM client in Card reader devices.

Key accomplishments include:
* Designed and developed DM client in Card reader devices.(RTOS and Linux)

positions.title: Sr. Principal Firmware Engineer
positions.description:
Sr. Staff ~ Sr. Principle Firmware engineer
As lead development engineer, designed and developed Bootrom, bootloader, run time security services and brought up new boards.

Key accomplishments include:
●	Designed and developed Secure Boot ROM and Boot image for single chip solutions(ARMV8 cores) for multi-AP cores
-	Designing and leading Trustzone and ARMV8 based secure boot and   
      runtime secure service solution
-	Developing Secure boot ROM which supports eMMC, SDCard, USB and UART 
      boot interfaces
-	Porting ARMTF boot image (BL3.1)

●	Designed and Developed Secure Boot ROM and Boot images for single chip solutions(ARMV7 cores) for multi-AP cores
-	Designed and leading Trustzone based secure boot and runtime secure service solution 
-	Developed Secure boot ROM which supports NAND, eMMC, USB, HSI and UART boot interfaces

●	Port SecureOS(Trustonic)
-	Port SecureOS in Android platform and developed Trustlet connector and Trustlet

●	Designed and Developed Boot ROM and Boot images for thin modem
-	Designed and developed Trustzone based Secure boot ROM which supports NAND, USB, HSI, SDIO and UART boot interfaces
         
●	Developed NOKIA custom Boot ROM, FOTA and flashing tool for NOKIA(BCM21351)
-	Designed and developed Trustzone based Secure boot ROM which supports NOR, OneNAND and USB boot interfaces

  
●	Board bring up for new HW platforms
-	Bring up new boards for new ASICs
-	Bring up initial customer boards

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
As lead development engineer, designed and developed DM(Device Management) and developed CDMA data.

Key accomplishments include:
* Developed OMA DM client and leading Device Management team for Sprint[MSM6800]
- Developing OMA DM client for Sprint and other carriers

* Developed FOTA(Firmware Over-The-Air) and leading FOTA team for Sprint[MSM6100,6500,6550]
- Developed Update Agent and FOTA application[IOTA based] for Firmware update, File system update and NV update
- Developed Full automation for FOTA process including update package and FOTA SCL generation for product team
- Componentized Update agent for supporting multi-carriers and multi-platforms with minimal change

* Developed IOTA(Internet Over-The-Air) feature for Sprint[MSM6100]
- Developed IOTA feature using Teleca’s BREW solution.

* Developed Data communication for China Unicom & Verizon [MSM6300]
- Developed H/W interface and modify protocol stack for CDMA data for carrier

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description:
As a development engineer, developed driver and port features(Bluetooth stack and BREW) in CDMA phones

Key accomplishments include:
* Ported Qualcomm Bluetooth stack in Motorola platform for MSM6100 based phone
- Developed Bluetooth DUN(Dialup Network) for Motorola platform

* Developed Multimedia H/W driver & API routines for Verizon[MSM5100]
- Made driver and API routines in Motorola platform for imaging chipset (Corelogic).

* Support Factory build[MSM5100]
- Developed J-tag downloader program, bootloader and ram downloader.

* Developed Sleep & OS related part in for SKT[MSM5500]
- For reducing sleep current, controlled RFT5600 chipset & other Motorola’s chipset.
- Debugged and fixed OS related problems caused by different OS (Vrtx vs Rex).

* Ported BREW in Motorola platform for KTF and Verizon[MSM5100]
- SMS interface, EVRC player, Serial interface and TAPI related parts

* Developed Extended AT Commands and Data Communication for SKT[MSM5100]

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
As a development engineer, developed BSP in CDMA phone and tools by using CDMA phone

Key accomplishments include:
* Developed MSM3000 based PCS Phone
- Developed H/W interface(GPIO, Memory) part and Serial download program.

* Developed AIS(Air Interface Simulator) System for Samsung by using Visual C++
- This could simulate handoff without phones' moving by using DM interface and controlling attenuation

* Developed CDMA Source Generator Application Program by using Visual C++
- This system used CDMA phone H/W for generating CDMA source and it’s controlled by PC via DM interface

* Developed Patent Search System using Visual Basic and MS SQLsever6.5

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
As a development engineer, designed and implemented speech recognition algorithm

Key accomplishments include:
* Developed Speech Recognition Algorithms by using Visual C++
- Developed Word based Recognizer Algorithms using Dynamic Time Warping Method.
